summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Woodside Energy Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on April 23, 2026. The filing includes the AGM address by the Chair and CEO, as well as voting results. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation. The document is a standard periodic report required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for foreign issuers, with no material corporate event or strategic change disclosed.
